summary: A 1953 Oregon Department of Forestry tower in Crook County, Oregon, after a 1932 crow's nest; firelookout.com reports private land with no public access.

access.note: firelookout.com says the tower is on private property with no public access. The register says it is in active service and does not describe access.

events.note: First lookout on the site, a crow's nest. The register says it went into service that year.
60-foot wooden tower and cab (register) or ground cabin (firelookout.com).
Present tower built by the Oregon Department of Forestry. Register says 40-foot laminated wood; firelookout.com says 50-foot wooden.

evidence.supports: administered by the Oregon Department of Forestry (register 'Administered by' field)
evidence.quote: Administered by Oregon Department of Forestry

evidence.supports: crow's nest in 1932, replaced two years later by a 60-foot tower and cab
evidence.quote: Foley Lookout first went into service as a crows nest in 1932 and two years later was replaced with a 60’ wooden tower and cab.

evidence.supports: crow's nest 1932, 60-foot tower and ground cabin 1934
evidence.quote: A crow's nest was built in 1932, followed by a 60' wooden tower and ground cabin in 1934.

evidence.supports: 1953 present tower: 40-foot laminated wood, hip roof, 14x14 live-in cab with catwalk
evidence.quote: In 1953 the Oregon Dept. of Forestry built the present 40’ laminated wood tower with a hip roof, permanent overhang 14’x14’ live in cab with catwalk.

evidence.supports: present 50-foot wooden tower built 1953; staffed every summer into the 2010s
evidence.quote: The present 50' wooden tower with ODF cab, built in 1953, was staffed every summer into the 2010's.

evidence.supports: private property with no public access
evidence.quote: It is located on private property with no public access.

notes_for_editor: Height of the 1953 tower is disputed: register says 40 ft laminated wood, firelookout.com says 50 ft wooden. The record's height_m 15.2 matches firelookout.com only; left as is, not changed. Access (private, no public access) and staffing (into the 2010s) come only from firelookout.com; the register says in active service without a date. Few sources were available, and the searches found no ODF or Wikipedia history. No photos gathered. Treat the access claim as needing confirmation before publishing.
